subject: Subprocessor lineage and source-attribution evidence for OrthoHealth SIG review
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@orthohealth.com>
To: logan_wright@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@orthohealth.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Subprocessor lineage and source-attribution evidence for SIG review

Hi Logan,

We're kicking off our SIG/CAIQ review for the upcoming OrthoHealth procurement cycle and need a clear trace of Redwood's runtime and third-party dependencies. Specifically can you provide:  

- Canonical subprocessor list (including versioned artifacts where applicable) and the date each entry was last validated.
- A short provenance note for model artifacts and any pre/post-processing steps that touch customer data (e.g., tokenization, K/V cache providers).
- Confirmation whether any subprocessor processes PHI/PII in a way that would change our controls (onshore vs offshore processing).
- A CAIQ/SIG crosswalk or index pointing to evidence items if available.

Our timeline is tight: would you be able to share an initial evidence bundle within 48 hours? If not, please propose a MAP with milestone dates.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Director, Vendor Risk — OrthoHealth

[attachment referenced: ORTHO_SIG_REQUEST_20260804.pdf]

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@orthohealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Subprocessor lineage and source-attribution evidence for SIG review

Elena —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can produce an initial bundle that covers the items below:

Deliverables (initial, within 48 hours):
- Subprocessor manifest (CSV) with last-validated timestamps and residency column. [attached: subprocessor_manifest_v4.csv]
- K/V cache & model artifact dependency diagram (PNG) showing source-of-origin and any third-party transforms. [attached: kvcache-dependency-diagram.png]
- SIG/CAIQ index (spreadsheet pointer) mapping common questions to evidence artifacts — Laura will attach a working index.
- Short note on PHI handling and whether any subprocessors perform onshore processing for sensitive data (we'll flag CacheStream).

We will also add an optional attestation template that your procurement team can sign for the residency and key-management statements (we can route via DocuSign). If you require a formal, signed attestation for CacheStream residency we can provide one by EOD tomorrow pending quick legal review.

Ben will align the manifest with our vendor IDs, Laura will operate the SIG index, and Grace will handle escalation and any SLA excerpts you need. If that plan works, we'll send the bundle and a short MAP by EOD tomorrow.

— Logan Wright
Senior Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

[attachment stubs included: subprocessor_manifest_v4.csv, kvcache-dependency-diagram.png]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@orthohealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 10:22:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Subprocessor lineage and source-attribution evidence for SIG review

Elena / team —

Attaching the SIG index (working): sig-evidence-index.xlsx. The index maps a subset of common SIG/CAIQ questions to our evidence artifacts and the manifest rows. Notes: 

- CacheStream (cachestream.io) appears in the manifest as a KV cache provider. Current configuration: staged ephemeral keys, logs redacted at collection point, and onshore processing for any requests flagged as "sensitive" by customer routing rules.
- KMS flow: our KMS provider is listed; we perform per-tenant key separation and rotating ephemeral wrapping keys every 24 hours. I included an exported KMS-residency excerpt in the index (sheet: KeyControls).
- Evidence gaps to call out: we do not currently have a CAIQ-ready DocuSign attestation for CacheStream residency; suggested path is to complete a short attestation and get a signature (we can pre-fill).

I'll also add an internal note column tying each manifest line to the last test (unit/integration) that validated the dependency.

Attachments: sig-evidence-index.xlsx.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Vendor Risk Analyst — Redwood Inference

[attachment: sig-evidence-index.xlsx (sheet: Index, KeyControls, Mapping)]
